title: Velo3D to Participate in the Lake Street Capital Markets 10th Annual Best Ideas Growth Conference in New York on September 10, 2026
body_markdown:
FREMONT, Calif.


, Sept. 1, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- **Velo3D, Inc. (Nasdaq: VELO)** , a leading metal additive manufacturing technology company, today announced that management will participate in the Lake Street Capital Markets 10th Annual Best Ideas Growth Conference in New York on September 10, 2026.


To learn more about the evens or to schedule a one-on-one meeting with management, please contact your conference representative or emailjames@haydenir.com.


**About Velo3D**


Velo3D is a metal 3D printing technology company that enables customers to build mission-critical metal parts. The fully integrated solution includes the Flow™ print preparation software, the Sapphire® family of printers and the Assure™ quality control system — all powered by Velo3D's Intelligent Fusion® manufacturing process. Learn more at[velo3d.com](https://www.velo3d.com/) .


Velo, Velo3D, Sapphire and Intelligent Fusion are registered trademarks of Velo3D, Inc. Flow and Assure are trademarks of Velo3D, Inc.
